function start_wave()
scratch = wave
scratch -= 1
limit = script_option[Option.wave_increase_seconds]
scratch *= limit
limit = script_option[Option.wave1_seconds]
scratch += limit
phase_timer = scratch
phase_timer.set_rate(-100%)
phase = Phase.wave
end

function close_menu()
if current_player.menu != Menu.closed then current_player.set_ui_menu(false) end
current_player.menu = Menu.closed
end

function make_infected()
close_menu()
current_player.role = Role.infected
current_player.pending = 0
current_player.form = 0
current_player.page = ZsClass.human
if current_player.is_not_respawning() then current_player.swap = 2 end
end

function open_shop()
ok = 0
if phase == Phase.warmup or phase == Phase.intermission then ok = 1 end
if phase == Phase.wave and crate != no_object then
scratch = current_player.biped.get_distance_to(crate)
limit = script_option[Option.crate_radius]
if scratch <= limit then ok = 1 end
end
if current_player.menu != Menu.closed then ok = 0 end
if ok == 0 then script_widget[6].set_text_for(current_player, "During a wave the arsenal opens only near the crate") end
if ok == 1 then
current_player.menu = Menu.shop
current_player.set_ui_menu(true)
script_widget[6].set_text_for(current_player, "")
end
end

price = 0
if item == Item.shotgun then price = 40 end

need = 0

if item == Item.missile_pod then need = 2 end
count = 0

scratch = avail
scratch &= need
if scratch == 0 then count = 1 end
end
end

function buy()
find_price()
ok = 1
scratch = script_option[Option.free_shop]
if scratch == 1 then price = 0 end
if current_player.points < price then
ok = 0
script_widget[6].set_text_for(current_player, "Not enough points: that costs %n", price)
end
if not current_player.buy_wait.is_zero() then
ok = 0
script_widget[6].set_text_for(current_player, "One purchase a second")
end
if item >= Item.cover and not current_player.carrying.is_zero() then
ok = 0
script_widget[6].set_text_for(current_player, "You already carry equipment: use it first")
end
if item >= Item.cover and current_player.pending > 0 then
ok = 0
script_widget[6].set_text_for(current_player, "Your grav lift's item isn't built yet")
end
check_map()
if count == 1 then
ok = 0
script_widget[6].set_text_for(current_player, "This map doesn't have that")
end
if item <= Item.fuel_rod_gun then
count = 0
for each object with label "zs_gun" do count += 1 end
limit = script_option[Option.gun_cap]
if count >= limit then
ok = 0
script_widget[6].set_text_for(current_player, "Too many bought guns lying around; pick some up first")
end
end
if ok == 1 then
current_player.points -= price
current_player.buy_wait = 1
current_player.buy_wait.set_rate(-100%)
if item == Item.shotgun then made = current_player.biped.place_at_me(shotgun, "zs_gun", none, 5, 0, 3, none) end
if item == Item.battle_rifle then made = current_player.biped.place_at_me(battle_rifle, "zs_gun", none, 5, 0, 3, none) end

if item == Item.mauler then made = current_player.biped.place_at_me(mauler, "zs_gun", none, 5, 0, 3, none) end
if item == Item.energy_sword then made = current_player.biped.place_at_me(energy_sword, "zs_gun", none, 5, 0, 3, none) end
if item == Item.flamethrower then made = current_player.biped.place_at_me(flamethrower, "zs_gun", none, 5, 0, 3, none) end
if item == Item.spartan_laser then made = current_player.biped.place_at_me(spartan_laser, "zs_gun", none, 5, 0, 3, none) end

if item == Item.beam_rifle then made = current_player.biped.place_at_me(beam_rifle, "zs_gun", none, 5, 0, 3, none) end
if item == Item.fuel_rod_gun then made = current_player.biped.place_at_me(fuel_rod_gun, "zs_gun", none, 5, 0, 3, none) end
if item <= Item.fuel_rod_gun then script_widget[6].set_text_for(current_player, "Bought: it's at your feet. Hold your pickup key on it") end
if item == Item.ammo then
current_player.refill_ammo()
script_widget[6].set_text_for(current_player, "Ammunition refilled")
end
if item == Item.cover then current_player.give_equipment(deployable_cover) end
if item == Item.bubble_shield then current_player.give_equipment(bubble_shield) end
if item == Item.regenerator then current_player.give_equipment(regenerator) end
if item == Item.trip_mine then current_player.give_equipment(trip_mine) end
if item == Item.radar_jammer then current_player.give_equipment(radar_jammer) end
if item == Item.active_camo then current_player.give_equipment(active_camo) end
if item == Item.invincibility then current_player.give_equipment(invincibility) end
if item >= Item.cover and item <= Item.invincibility then
current_player.carrying = 1
script_widget[6].set_text_for(current_player, "Bought: use it with your Use Equipment key")
end
if item >= Item.turret then

current_player.give_equipment(grav_lift)

function form_need()
need = 0

function pick_form()
class = current_player.page
if class < ZsClass.human or class > ZsClass.spartan_boss then class = ZsClass.human end
if class > ZsClass.stalker and class < ZsClass.nest_stalker then class = ZsClass.human end
if class >= ZsClass.juggernaut then
if current_player != boss or boss_used == 1 then class = ZsClass.human end
end
ok = 0
scratch = phase_timer
if phase == Phase.intermission and scratch > 6 then ok = 1 end
if ok == 1 then class = ZsClass.monitor end
if ok == 0 and class == ZsClass.monitor then class = ZsClass.human end
end

function spawn_form()

if phase != Phase.wave or wave < limit then count = 0 end

function place_object()

end

end

function purge()
for each object do
if current_object.is_of_type(vehicle) then
ok = 1
if current_object.has_forge_label("zs_turret") or current_object.has_forge_label("zs_plasma") then ok = 0 end
if current_object.has_forge_label("zs_pod") then ok = 0 end
if ok == 1 then
if current_object.is_of_type(plasma_cannon_emplacement) then avail |= 1 end
if current_object.is_of_type(missile_pod_emplacement) then avail |= 2 end
current_object.delete()
end
end
if current_object.is_of_type(weapon) and not current_object.has_forge_label("zs_gun") then
ok = 1
holder = current_object.get_carrier()
if holder != no_player then ok = 0 end
for each player do
if current_player.is_not_respawning() then
scratch = current_player.biped.get_distance_to(current_object)
if scratch < 6 then ok = 0 end
end
end
if ok == 1 then current_object.delete() end
end
end
end

end
end
if class == ZsClass.monitor then
current_player.set_vehicle_use(false)
current_player.set_turret_use(false)
end
if class >= ZsClass.survivor and class != ZsClass.monitor then
current_player.set_vehicle_use(true)
current_player.set_turret_use(true)
end
if current_player.role == Role.survivor then
current_player.set_max_shields(50)
if current_player.is_not_respawning() then
scratch = current_player.perks
need = scratch
need &= Perk.fast
if need != 0 then current_player.apply_traits(script_traits[2]) end
need = scratch
need &= Perk.slow
if need != 0 then current_player.apply_traits(script_traits[3]) end
need = scratch
need &= Perk.overshield
if need != 0 then current_player.apply_traits(script_traits[4]) end
need = scratch
need &= Perk.frail
if need != 0 then current_player.apply_traits(script_traits[5]) end
need = scratch
need &= Perk.hard_hitter
if need != 0 then current_player.apply_traits(script_traits[6]) end
need = scratch
need &= Perk.weak_arm
if need != 0 then current_player.apply_traits(script_traits[7]) end
need = scratch
need &= Perk.grenadier
if need != 0 then current_player.apply_traits(script_traits[8]) end
need = scratch
need &= Perk.tough
if need != 0 then current_player.apply_traits(script_traits[9]) end
end
end
if current_player.role == Role.infected then current_player.set_max_shields(100) end
scratch = current_player.get_death_count()
if scratch != current_player.deaths then
current_player.deaths = scratch
current_player.carrying = 0
ok = 1
if current_player.swap > 0 then
current_player.swap = 0
ok = 0
end
if ok == 1 and current_player.role == Role.survivor and phase != Phase.warmup then
make_infected()
converted += 1
end
end
scratch = current_player.get_kill_count()
scratch -= current_player.kills
current_player.kills = current_player.get_kill_count()
if scratch > 0 and current_player.role == Role.survivor then
limit = script_option[Option.kill_points]
scratch *= limit
current_player.points += scratch
end
if current_player.points > 100000 then current_player.points = 100000 end
if current_player.role == Role.survivor and current_player.team != team[0] then current_player.team = team[0] end
if current_player.role == Role.infected and current_player.team != team[1] then current_player.team = team[1] end
end

total = converted
total += survivors
if wave > 0 then
scratch = wave
scratch -= 1
need = script_option[Option.tier_step_waves]
scratch /= need
if scratch > 3 then scratch = 3 end
if scratch > unlock then unlock = scratch end
end

for each player do
class = current_player.get_deployment_class()
ok = 0
if current_player.role == Role.survivor and not current_player.is_not_respawning() and class == -1 and phase != Phase.over then
need = current_player.perks
need &= Perk.ready
if need != 0 then
count = ZsClass.survivor
scratch = current_player.perks
scratch &= Perk.grenadier
if scratch != 0 then count = ZsClass.grenadier end
scratch = current_player.perks
scratch &= Perk.assault
if scratch != 0 and count == ZsClass.grenadier then count = ZsClass.assault_grenadier end
if scratch != 0 and count == ZsClass.survivor then count = ZsClass.assault end
scratch = current_player.deploy_class(count)
end
if need == 0 then ok = 2 end
end
scratch = current_player.get_respawn_time()
if current_player.role == Role.infected and not current_player.is_not_respawning() and class == -1 and scratch == 0 and phase != Phase.over then ok = 1 end
if ok == 1 and current_player.menu == Menu.closed then
current_player.menu = Menu.picker
current_player.set_ui_menu(true)
end
if ok == 2 and current_player.menu == Menu.closed then
current_player.menu = Menu.traits
current_player.set_ui_menu(true)
end
if ok != 1 and current_player.menu == Menu.picker then close_menu() end
if ok != 2 and current_player.menu == Menu.traits then close_menu() end
if current_player.menu == Menu.shop and not current_player.is_not_respawning() then close_menu() end
end

if crate == no_object then
for each player do
if crate == no_object and current_player.role == Role.survivor and current_player.is_not_respawning() then
crate = current_player.biped.place_at_me(marine, "zs_crate", never_garbage_collect, 20, 0, 0, none)
crate.copy_rotation_from(current_player.biped, false)
crate.set_invincibility(true)
crate.set_garbage_collection_disabled(true)
end
end
end

if pulse.is_zero() then
limit = script_option[Option.crate_radius]
for each player do
if current_player.role == Role.survivor and current_player.is_not_respawning() and crate != no_object then
scratch = current_player.biped.get_distance_to(crate)
if scratch <= limit then current_player.refill_ammo() end
end
end
pulse.reset()
pulse.set_rate(-100%)
end

for each object do
if current_object.is_of_type(grav_lift) then current_object.age += 1 end
end
for each player do
if current_player.pending > 0 and current_player.is_not_respawning() then
if current_player.tool == no_object and not current_player.watch.is_zero() then
made = no_object
limit = 100000
for each object do
if current_object.is_of_type(grav_lift) and current_object.claimed == 0 and current_object.age < 90 then
scratch = current_object.get_distance_to(current_player.biped)
if scratch < limit then
limit = scratch
made = current_object
end
end
end
if made != no_object then
made.claimed = 1
current_player.tool = made
end
end
if current_player.tool != no_object then
scratch = current_player.tool.get_speed()
count = current_player.tool.age
if scratch == 0 and count >= 5 then place_object() end
end
if current_player.carrying.is_zero() and current_player.watch.is_zero() and current_player.tool == no_object and current_player.pending > 0 then
current_player.give_equipment(grav_lift)
current_player.carrying = 1
end
end
end

seconds = phase_timer
limit = script_option[Option.min_players]
if phase == Phase.warmup then
script_widget[0].set_text("WARMUP  |  outbreak in %n s", seconds)
if players < limit then script_widget[0].set_text("ZOMBIE SURVIVAL  |  waiting for %n players", limit) end
end
if phase == Phase.wave then
limit = script_option[Option.wave_count]
script_widget[0].set_text("WAVE %n / %n  |  %n s left", wave, limit, seconds)
end
if phase == Phase.intermission then
scratch = wave
scratch += 1
script_widget[0].set_text("BREAK  |  wave %n starts in %n s  |  arsenal open anywhere", scratch, seconds)
end
script_widget[1].set_text("Survivors %n  |  Infected %n  |  Flood forms unlocked %n / 3", survivors, infected, unlock)
script_widget[0].set_visibility(all_players, true)
script_widget[1].set_visibility(all_players, true)
script_widget[6].set_visibility(all_players, true)

for each player do
script_widget[18].set_visibility(current_player, false)
if current_player.role == Role.survivor then
script_widget[2].set_text_for(current_player, "%n points", current_player.points)
limit = script_option[Option.free_shop]
if limit == 1 then script_widget[2].set_text_for(current_player, "%n points  |  test mode: the arsenal is FREE", current_player.points) end
script_widget[3].set_text_for(current_player, "Ability 1: arsenal")
if current_player.pending == Item.turret then script_widget[3].set_text_for(current_player, "Your next grav lift becomes: Machine Gun Emplacement") end
if current_player.pending == Item.wall then script_widget[3].set_text_for(current_player, "Your next grav lift becomes: Barrier (Hunter)") end
if current_player.pending == Item.plasma_cannon then script_widget[3].set_text_for(current_player, "Your next grav lift becomes: Plasma Cannon") end
if current_player.pending == Item.missile_pod then script_widget[3].set_text_for(current_player, "Your next grav lift becomes: Missile Pod") end
if phase == Phase.wave and crate != no_object and current_player.is_not_respawning() then
scratch = current_player.biped.get_distance_to(crate)
limit = script_option[Option.crate_radius]
script_widget[18].set_text_for(current_player, "Crate %n ft away  |  arsenal and ammo within %n ft", scratch, limit)
script_widget[18].set_visibility(current_player, true)
end
end
if current_player.role == Role.infected then
script_widget[2].set_text_for(current_player, "Survivors converted: %n of %n", converted, total)
script_widget[3].set_text_for(current_player, "Infected: hunt the Survivors down")
class = current_player.get_deployment_class()
if class == ZsClass.monitor then script_widget[3].set_text_for(current_player, "Monitor: you rise as Flood when the next wave starts") end
if class == ZsClass.nest_stalker then
scratch = nest_wait
script_widget[3].set_text_for(current_player, "Nest Stalker  |  A1 build the nest (ready in %n s)", scratch)
if nest != no_object then script_widget[3].set_text_for(current_player, "Nest Stalker  |  your team's nest is standing") end
end
scratch = current_player.morph_wait
if class == ZsClass.turret_stalker then script_widget[3].set_text_for(current_player, "Turret Stalker  |  A1 turret form on / off (ready in %n s)", scratch) end
if class == ZsClass.tank_stalker then script_widget[3].set_text_for(current_player, "Tank Stalker  |  A1 Tank form on / off (ready in %n s)", scratch) end
end
script_widget[2].set_visibility(current_player, true)
script_widget[3].set_visibility(current_player, true)
hide_menu()
if current_player.menu == Menu.shop or current_player.menu == Menu.traits then
if current_player.menu == Menu.shop then draw_shop() end
if current_player.menu == Menu.traits then draw_traits() end
script_widget[4].set_visibility(current_player, true)
script_widget[5].set_visibility(current_player, true)
script_widget[7].set_visibility(current_player, true)
script_widget[8].set_visibility(current_player, true)
script_widget[9].set_visibility(current_player, true)
script_widget[10].set_visibility(current_player, true)
if current_player.menu == Menu.traits or current_player.page != 3 then
script_widget[11].set_visibility(current_player, true)
script_widget[12].set_visibility(current_player, true)
script_widget[13].set_visibility(current_player, true)
script_widget[14].set_visibility(current_player, true)
end
if current_player.menu == Menu.shop then
script_widget[15].set_visibility(current_player, true)
script_widget[16].set_visibility(current_player, true)
end
if current_player.menu == Menu.traits then script_widget[19].set_visibility(current_player, true) end
script_widget[17].set_visibility(current_player, true)
end
if current_player.menu == Menu.picker then
draw_picker()
script_widget[4].set_visibility(current_player, true)
script_widget[5].set_visibility(current_player, true)
script_widget[7].set_visibility(current_player, true)
script_widget[15].set_visibility(current_player, true)
if ok == 0 then
script_widget[8].set_visibility(current_player, true)
script_widget[9].set_visibility(current_player, true)
script_widget[10].set_visibility(current_player, true)
script_widget[11].set_visibility(current_player, true)
script_widget[12].set_visibility(current_player, true)
script_widget[13].set_visibility(current_player, true)
script_widget[14].set_visibility(current_player, true)
script_widget[19].set_visibility(current_player, true)
if current_player == boss and boss_used == 0 then script_widget[20].set_visibility(current_player, true) end
end
if nest != no_object then script_widget[16].set_visibility(current_player, true) end
end
end
